{{Quote|Excellent! I forget the delivery agent's name, but he's a Drall, one of those little furry folks. I expect he must be a young fan eager to get into the world of swoop racing. Bring him here and give him a thrill.|Ignar Ominaz|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Hamber''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] guard and delivery agent who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Are you from the customer who ordered this power converter?''"<br />"''What kind of idiot tries to fine-tune a swoop bike in the Agrilat Swamp? The crystal growth will ruin this power converter. Bring me to this nincompoop, and I'll tell him where he's gone wrong.|Hamber|<ref name="SWG:AED" />}}
Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] escorted Hamber to [[Ignar Ominaz]].

{{Char-stub}}
